regions.contentLimits: One administration label and one demo navigation link.
regions.overflow: The navigation link stays reachable on narrow viewports.

regions.contentLimits: Three section controls: screens, one-liner, and local data.
regions.overflow: Controls wrap while preserving visible labels on compact viewports.

regions.contentLimits: One editor for ordered Gallery, Breathing, and RUST gateway screens. Gallery screens contain ordered pre-filled or visitor-upload image tiles with an assigned sentence per tile.
regions.overflow: Screen and tile names truncate in their rows. Actions wrap on compact viewports. The editor follows normal document scrolling.

regions.contentLimits: One final-page visitor one-liner enablement setting, prompt, and placeholder.
regions.overflow: Text inputs remain readable in a narrow single column.

regions.contentLimits: One browser-storage estimate and one reset action.
regions.overflow: The estimate wraps inside its card.

regions.contentLimits: One screen, tile, or destructive confirmation dialog at a time.
regions.overflow: Dialog content scrolls when a compact viewport cannot contain it.

responsive.compact: Section controls wrap. The screen editor keeps every screen and tile in one column, and actions wrap without hiding names or primary actions.
responsive.wide: The screen editor stays a single wide working surface. One-liner and local data use their own focused cards.

focus.onOpen: An add, edit, or confirmation dialog moves focus into itself and traps it.
focus.onClose: Focus returns to the action that opened the dialog.
focus.onError: The save-result region announces the message while focus stays on the active control.

accessibility.headings: One h1 for the administration task, then one h2 per active section and one h3 per configured screen.
accessibility.labels: Every text and file input has a visible label. Reorder, duplicate, edit, and remove controls name their screen or tile.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: Save, validation, delete, and reset results use a polite live region.
